name: filmstrip
description: Tile a uniform time-grid of frames into filmstrip contact sheets, with an index JSON mapping every tile to its timestamp. Input is a video (pure ffmpeg), an overlay .jsx or engine:scene3d (one Chromium session). Feeds a timeline scrubber thumbnail strip — unlike shot_sheet this samples on a fixed time grid, not per detected shot.

input.description: Source video file (all-intra proxy expected for cheap per-tile seeking), an overlay .jsx (needs duration), or engine:scene3d (needs duration, project, props {scene, inPoint})

output.description: {sheets:[{path, cols, rows, tiles:[{t, row, col}]}], interval, tileWidth}; an overlay adds tileHeight and is cached under out-dir

params.name: out-dir
params.description: Directory to write sheet images into

params.name: max-tiles
params.description: Total tile budget across the whole filmstrip; bounds interval = max(duration/max-tiles, min-interval)

params.name: tiles-per-sheet
params.description: Tiles per sheet before splitting into another sheet

params.name: google-fonts
params.description: Overlay only: Google Fonts, a comma list or JSON array

params.name: fps
params.description: Overlay only: frame rate of the fps global

params.name: duration
params.description: Overlay only, required: length in seconds

params.name: width
params.description: Overlay only: canvas width; with height sets the tile aspect

params.name: project
params.description: 3D only: the project (id, folder or project.json) whose models/ holds the scene
